alternatives.name: SGP30
alternatives.note: Cheaper, but eCO2 is estimated from VOCs, not measured.

description: True CO2 (photoacoustic NDIR) in ppm plus temperature and humidity: SCD40 / SCD41

calibrate.description: Forced recalibration to a known CO2 level in ppm (e.g. 420 outdoors) after 3 min of stable readings; returns the correction applied in ppm, or -32768 on failure.

ready.description: True once the first measurement has been read.

set_auto_calibration.description: Turn automatic self-calibration on or off (on by default).

set_pressure.description: Ambient pressure in hPa for pressure compensation (e.g. from a BME280); can be called at any time.

set_temperature_offset.description: Self-heating offset in °C subtracted from the temperature reading (default 4).

name: SCD4x

specs.current: ~15 mA average in periodic mode (peaks 175 mA)

tips: A new value arrives every 5 s; reading more often returns the last value. ready() is false until the first one (about 5 s after boot).

Automatic self-calibration assumes it sees fresh outdoor air (~420 ppm) at least once a week; turn it off with set_auto_calibration(false) in rooms that never get that, and use calibrate(420) outdoors instead.
calibrate(), set_temperature_offset() and set_auto_calibration() pause measurements for about 1 s and are not kept across power loss.
Self-heating makes it read 2-4 °C warm in an enclosure; correct it with set_temperature_offset().

pins.label: VDD
pins.note: 3.3V or 5V; needs a solid supply for the 175 mA peaks

pins.label: SDA
pins.note: I2C data, pull-up on most breakouts
